verdict.rationale: Ashby ships in-product AI insights from customer data. Ashby Assistant is a chat agent that analyzes pipelines and returns updates covering candidate sentiment, stage and interview concerns. AI rediscovery scans existing candidates and surfaces key signals, and the AI Notetaker summarizes interviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth first-party documentation beyond product-update announcements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: A chat-based agent that lets you ask questions in plain language and take action across Ashby from a single interface. Analyze pipelines, update candidates, draft emails, and more
you can ask for a pipeline update on an open Product Engineer role that includes candidate sentiment, current stage, and concerns raised in interviews.
Use AI to scan your existing candidates, match them against job criteria, and surface key signals for rediscovery.
Ashby's native AI Notetaker records, transcribes, and summarizes your interviews.
